_doc: VTID-05183 — every web module @vitana/core re-exports, with its reason and consumer lanes. A lane that needs another transitively class-A module adds a line here and a re-export in its own PR; scripts/native/core-closure.mjs --check is the gate (it fails on a re-export missing here, a line nothing re-exports, or a module that is not class A).

src/navigation/registry/index.ts.reason: The screen registry (titles, voice targets, locale titles): route titles, deep link → screen, ORB navigation. Imports only screens.json and locale files.

src/navigation/orb-navigation.ts.reason: ORB navigation directives (planOrbNavigation, eventForMarker). Imports only the registry.

src/lib/orb-view-profile.ts.reason: ORB view profile (orbViewProfile: surface + view role the ORB declares at session start). Imports nothing; pure.

src/lib/permissions.ts.reason: Role/tenant switch permissions from the session; pure.

src/lib/news-images.ts.reason: News cover-image selection and longevity-pillar mapping (getNewsImage, getArticlePillar, LONGEVITY_PILLARS). Imports nothing; pure. Used by the native NewsArticleCard twin and the news reader.

src/lib/exchangeRates.ts.reason: Wallet exchange-rate helpers (getCurrentExchangeRates, getExchangeRate, calculateExchange, getCurrencySymbol, convertFromUsd, convertToUsd, EUR_PER_USD). Imports nothing; pure. Used by the native BookingPaymentFlow twin (marketplace-orders: getExchangeRate, formatCurrency) and the native wallet hub and balance screens.

src/components/vitana/vitana-card-catalo.reason: Pure Unified-Card-System catalog (pickHomeServerCards, isVitanaCardType, cardCategory, CARD_SCREENS, CARD_DEEP_LINKS); no imports.

src/integrations/supabase/types.ts.reason: The generated Database type for the injected Supabase client (type only, erased from the bundle).

src/integrations/supabase/data-routing.t.reason: createDataFetch: routes PostgREST to the data API when configured, the same as the web client; pure.

src/lib/horizonBuckets.ts.reason: My Journey horizon bucketing (bucketFromWaveId, bucketActions, HORIZON_BUCKETS). Pure; its one import is the type-only @/types/autopilot. The native dashboard buckets the onboarding recommendations into "today" with it.

src/lib/vitana-projection.ts.reason: Vitana Index slope helpers (trend7d, projectDays, projectDay90, buildHorizonPoints). Imports nothing; pure. The native "how you are doing" card reads the 7-day trend through it.

src/lib/goalPhases.ts.reason: Goal-plan phase segments (buildPhases, RingPhase). Imports nothing; pure. The native hero ring and plan-sheet ring colour their phases with it.

src/lib/vitanaIndex.ts.reason: The Vitana Index tier table (VITANA_INDEX_TIERS, getVitanaIndexTier). Imports nothing; pure. The native My Journey Index cards label the tier with it.

src/lib/audiobook/queue.ts.reason: Audiobook season order and queue helpers (AUDIOBOOK_SEASONS, seasonNumber). Imports nothing; pure. The native guided-journey catalog orders and labels its chapters with it.

src/lib/messaging/grouping.ts.reason: Message grouping positions (groupPositions, isGroupStart, isGroupEnd). Imports nothing; pure. Used by the native conversation and group chat lists.

src/lib/mentions.ts.reason: @mention helpers (findActiveMentionToken, insertMention, addMention, pruneMentions, splitMentionSegments, filterLocalCandidates). Imports nothing; pure. Used by the native composer and message bubble.

src/lib/messaging/groupSystemNotice.ts.reason: Group system-notice text (describeGroupNotice, noticeName). Imports nothing; pure. Used by the native message bubble and members modal.

src/lib/messaging/groupManagement.ts.reason: Group rename / participant deactivate over an injected client (renameGlobalGroup, deactivateParticipant). Imports nothing; pure. Used by the native members modal.

src/lib/chatMarkdown.ts.reason: Vitana chat-reply Markdown parser (parseChatMarkdown, parseChatInline, MdBlock, MdInline). Imports nothing; pure. Used by the native message bubble for the Vitana bot's replies (VTID-05193).
